If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TwistsTurnsSFRAA2026#68781-associados-aps-aps-associates).

items.name: Pocatello Potato Palooza 2026

venue.name: Idaho State University Pond Student Union Building

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full). If you are new to competing, please refer to the Newcomer Information tab. 

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the Registration and Waitlist Info tab. 

Go to our [website](https://utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

items.name: DFW Cubing Spring 2026
items.information:
## Southern Cubing welcomes you to Arlington, Texas for DFW Cubing Spring 2026! This competition will feature the WCA's new Head-to-Head format in FOUR different events! Check out the [Head-to-Head tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2026#69237-head-to-head) for additional information.

***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue, however it is permitted in the foyer outside the expo hall.***

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
